environment.description: ECS Fargate task with dedicated ephemeral storage (no shared volumes). Database connection authenticates via IAM database authentication to an Aurora PostgreSQL cluster. The IAM role attached to the task (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/sqs-consumer-prod) has an inline policy granting rds-db:connect to the database resource with dbuser 'readonly_consumer'. The PostgreSQL role 'readonly_consumer' was provisioned with: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO readonly_consumer; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO readonly_consumer; No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE privileges exist for this role. pg_hba.conf enforces that the 'readonly_consumer' user can only connect from the task's security group CIDR. Additionally, the Aurora cluster has query_activity_logging enabled and a CloudWatch alarm triggers on any DML attempt by this user.

config.db_privileges: SELECT ONLY on public schema tables
config.pg_role_config: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO readonly_consumer
config.monitoring: pgaudit + CloudWatch alarm on DML by readonly_consumer
